========================================
_Thread_local storage class
========================================

_Thread_local int x;
static _Thread_local int y;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration (storage_class_specifier) type: (primitive_type) declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration (storage_class_specifier) (storage_class_specifier) type: (primitive_type) declarator: (identifier)))

========================================
__signed spellings of signed
========================================

typedef __signed char i8;
__signed__ int y;

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition type: (sized_type_specifier type: (primitive_type)) declarator: (type_identifier))
  (declaration type: (sized_type_specifier type: (primitive_type)) declarator: (identifier)))

========================================
register variable with an asm label and an initializer
========================================

long f(long n) {
  register long a7 __asm__("a7") = n;
  return a7;
}

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (sized_type_specifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration type: (sized_type_specifier) declarator: (identifier))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (declaration
        (storage_class_specifier)
        type: (sized_type_specifier)
        declarator: (init_declarator
          declarator: (identifier)
          (gnu_asm_expression assembly_code: (string_literal (string_content)))
          value: (identifier)))
      (return_statement (identifier)))))
